title: TCR-Peptide Pretraining & Bidirectional DMS
subtitle: 234k Zero-Leakage Pairs, 71 Peptide DMS, 23 TCR CDR3 DMS & TCR3d <5 A Contacts
description:
# TCR–Peptide Pretraining & Bidirectional DMS Benchmark

Zero-leakage paired T-cell receptor (`CDR3β|CDR3α`) – peptide epitope dataset used in **LogiCA** (*Contextualizing Biological Language Models via Logit-Space Contrastive Alignment*), covering both **peptide-anchored** and **TCR-anchored** mutational scanning alongside pretraining, binary recognition, and structural crystal contacts:
- **Stage-1 Zero-Leakage Repertoire Pretraining (`pretrain/`)**: `234,147` train + `26,016` val positive `(CDR3β|CDR3α, epitope)` pairs from `EPACT + STAPLER + IEDB` (`151,482` unique TCRs, `1,559` epitopes, `0%` overlap with all downstream benchmarks).
- **Stage-2 Supervised Fine-Tuning (`finetune/`)**: Deduplicated `EPACT` binary split (`19,882` train, `2,210` val).
- **Peptide-Anchored DMS (`peptide_dms/`, `71` groups)**: `ePytope-Mutation` (`4,244` rows), `BATCAVE` (`5,754` / `11,967` full), and `ATLAS-Pep` (`60`).
- **TCR-Anchored CDR3 DMS (`tcr_dms/`, `23` groups · `703` variants)**: Combined `ATLAS-CDR + TRAIT 2025 + SKEMPI v2` (`207` quantitative $K_D$ variants) + `868-Z11` 20-AA CDR3α/β saturation DMS (`496` variants), plus original `ATLAS-CDR` (`128`).
- **Held-Out Binary Benchmarks (`binary_benchmarks/`)**: `ePytope-Binary` (`7,176` pairs) & `IMMREP2025` (`10,000` pairs with HLA alleles).
- **TCR3d `<5 Å` Crystal Contacts (`tcr3d_contacts/`)**: `371` resolved paired TCR–pMHC crystal complexes with exact CDR3α/β–epitope heavy-atom minimum distances and `<5 Å` contact labels (`101,962` residue pairs, `5,612` contacts).
- **Precomputed 12-Model Baseline Tables (`baseline_scores/`)**: Per-variant predictions on the 703 TCR DMS variants and per-group correlations across all `71` peptide + `23` TCR DMS groups.

---

## Quickstart

```python
from pathlib import Path
import kagglehub
import pandas as pd

root = Path(kagglehub.dataset_download("aurlienplissier/tcr-peptide-dms"))

# 1. Pretraining & fine-tuning splits (0% downstream leakage)
pretrain = pd.read_csv(root / "pretrain/epact_stapler_iedb_train_non_overlap.csv")
ft_train = pd.read_csv(root / "finetune/epact_train.csv")

# 2. Peptide-anchored & TCR-anchored mutational DMS benchmarks
pep_dms = pd.read_csv(root / "peptide_dms/epytope_mutation_test.csv")
tcr_dms = pd.read_csv(root / "tcr_dms/tcr_mutations_combined_test.csv")

# 3. TCR3d <5 A CDR3-epitope crystal contact maps
tcr3d_complexes = pd.read_csv(root / "tcr3d_contacts/tcr3d_complexes.csv")
tcr3d_contacts = pd.read_parquet(root / "tcr3d_contacts/tcr3d_residue_contacts.parquet")
```

Run directly with **`AI-SysBio/LogiCA`**:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/AI-SysBio/LogiCA.git && cd LogiCA
pip install -e ".[tcr]"
python applications/tcrlang-esm/scripts/01_fetch_and_prepare_tcr_data.py --kaggle-dataset aurlienplissier/tcr-peptide-dms
python applications/tcrlang-esm/scripts/04_evaluate_dms_and_checkpoints.py --kaggle-dataset aurlienplissier/tcr-peptide-dms --hf-subfolder dual-anchored-ratio5
```

Compiled from EPACT, STAPLER, IEDB, ePytope, BATCAVE, ATLAS, IMMREP2025, TRAIT 2025, SKEMPI v2, Zenodo `10685013` (868-Z11), and TCR3d (`tcr3d.ibbr.umd.edu`). See `SOURCES_AND_LICENSES.md` for full citations and per-source licenses.
